## IFileDeletionPresentationContext interface

A proposal to delete a whole file that exists at the reviewed commit, shown in the review body with the findings that carry it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface IFileDeletionPresentationContext extends IPresentationContext 
```
**Extends:** [IPresentationContext](./sarif-to-comment.ipresentationcontext.md)

## Remarks

`required` holds the file's permalink and the findings.
